classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that the missing radius is needed for surface area, recover it by subtracting squared perpendicular height from squared slant height, and then apply the total-area formula.

content.prompt: Calculate the surface area of the cone. Answer to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Inverted unshaded cone with a complete visible upper circular rim, solid tangent silhouettes, a dashed perpendicular height and a leader arrow identifying that height. Ordinary source blue and grey strokes are rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: Slant height 7 cm and perpendicular height 5.6 cm. The radius is not supplied and must be calculated.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given lengths are visible in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Using Pythagoras,
$$\begin{align*}r^2&=l^2-h^2\\r^2&=7^2-5.6^2\\r^2&=17.64\\r&=4.2\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
The total surface area includes the circular base.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\pi r^2+\pi rl\\A&=\pi(4.2)^2+\pi(4.2)(7)\\A&=47.04\pi\\A&\approx147.78\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
